description:
Astralith 🚀 Forgotten by time, remembered among the stars.

We are a team of curious minds, creative thinkers, and space enthusiasts driven by a passion for exploration and storytelling. Through research, technology, creativity, and data, we aim to uncover the forgotten stories of abandoned human-made equipment on the Moon and Mars. We believe every forgotten machine holds a story worth telling. Join us to turn remnants of exploration into echoes that inspire the future!
